config.note: lambda_sparse 1.0 and above zero every row of U within the 300-epoch budget (measured on fold0 inner0), while 0.1 and below zero none; the grid therefore spans the observed transition instead of assuming intermediate sparsity. lambda_sparse 0.0 equals the dense_modulation penalty setting, kept so the same entry can be compared with the proximal variants.
config.comparator_note: Comparators are owned by lcm_comparators.py and must expose the trainer interface (initialize, parameter_groups, proximal, zero_rows, count, set_additive); the entry raises if that is not yet implemented.

rule: per variant, mean inner-fold macro PCC across environments selects the grid entry; earliest entry on ties; refit runs the median of inner best epochs
protocol: CV1 material-level; centering, standardization and ridge initialization from the fitting rows only; float32 training with float64 analytic references; test evaluated once after the frozen selection
objective: mean squared error plus lambda_A on additive coefficients, lambda_N on background, response network and readout, and proximal group penalty lambda_S on rows of U
